sources.claim: Native map identity and independently selected architecture/perimeter targets. Large badge occlusions are supplied by original owner images.
Original owner closeup supplies seven architecture controls, nine heldout checks, west-curve samples and visible perimeter/gate approaches. Badge and cursor decorations are excluded.

Original owner overview corroborates zone identity, north/west footprint and the eastern line partly crossed by the closeup cursor. Its own badge/Travel Here overlays are excluded; it is not fitted calibration.

registration.method: Seven-control architecture homography; five architecture and four perimeter holdouts. Original-pixel correction of one heldout roof corner leaves the fit unchanged. Visible curve, cursor occlusions and north display closure reviewed.

notes: Rendered map-selection footprint only; no physical, walking, floor, accessible-entrance, route, spawn or complete encounter-extent claim. Full area scope remains incomplete.
Three native pixels is observed raster/manual digitization tolerance, not a statistical confidence interval or guarantee about hidden game-world edges.

Original closeup supplies the curved west side and corners. Its two short eastern cursor-ring crossings are checked against visible approaches/internal line and the matching original overview. Native badge silhouette is excluded.
One northern gate-symbol span is an explicit display closure between observed approaches. No continuous hidden physical line or accessible entrance is asserted.

The failed first H2 pick/error and original fit are retained. Only the demonstrably misplaced heldout target was corrected from original pixel identity; no control, fitted matrix or perimeter candidate changed.
Existing approximate marker center, original source bytes, player state and roster status are unchanged.
